    SELECT TOP(1) [u].[Id], [u].[Address], [u].[Code], [u].[CreatedAt], [u].[Email], [u].[Name], [u].[ParentId], [u].[Phone], [u0].[Id] AS [Id0], [u0].[Address] AS [Address0], [u0].[Code] AS [Code0], [u0].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [u0].[Email] AS [Email0], [u0].[Name] AS [Name0], [u0].[ParentId] AS [ParentId0], [u0].[Phone] AS [Phone0]
    FROM [Units] AS [u]
    LEFT JOIN [Units] AS [u0] ON [u].[ParentId] = [u0].[Id]
    WHERE [u].[Id] = @__id_0
) AS [t]
LEFT JOIN [Units] AS [u1] ON [t].[Id] = [u1].[ParentId]
LEFT JOIN [Members] AS [m] ON [t].[Id] = [m].[UnitId]
ORDER BY [t].[Id], [t].[Id0], [u1].[Id]
